summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the inclusion of a frame report in the release notes and potential delays. The frame report is currently being debugged and will be deployed today. A delay was noted regarding dashboard updates, as new views do not support the necessary function merge(). However, the frame report itself is confirmed for inclusion.

Regarding the release date, initial concerns about campaign readiness were discussed. After some negotiation, a target date of Thursday was tentatively agreed upon.
decisions: The frame report will be included in the release notes.
The planned release date is set for Thursday.
action_items: Debug and deploy the frame report today.
Implement necessary function merge() fix for dashboard views.
